GSAP 3.15.0 (https://gsap.com), copied unmodified from the npm package `gsap@3.15.0` (dist/*.min.js)
and concatenated into gsap-bundle.js: gsap core, CustomEase, SplitText, DrawSVGPlugin, MorphSVGPlugin,
MotionPathPlugin.
